messages:
ops-lead: :loud_sound: Nightly SLO sensitivity exercise tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC. We will run a controlled concurrency surge against the text-gen and embeddings routes to validate degradation paths and fallback policies. Goal: verify guardrails, autoscale triggers, and canary-region behavior. Expected impact: brief p95/p99 latency increases for non-production tiers; no customer token loss. Please avoid deploys to main for the window. Runbook + dashboards: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-sensitivity-2026

alex: ack. Can you list the exact routes and model variants we'll hit? need to check canary mapping.

ops-lead: good Q — load targets: /v1/generate (model: rwd-open-3b-quant), /v1/embed (model: rwd-embed-lite). Canary region will be eu-west-1 only for the first 5 minutes, then scale to us-west-2 if steady.

maria: loadgen config (will run from k8s job):
```
concurrency: 250
qps: 120
routes:
 - /v1/generate
 - /v1/embed
headers:
  x-org-id: test-load
```

jordan: rollback plan? if we see token errors or >1% 5xxs in customer tier we stop and revert routing to safety pool. who has permission to flip that?

ops-lead: oncall and ops-engineering can flip the routing boolean (sre-admin). Rollback steps in runbook. Primary escalation: @alex, secondary @emma.

emma: happy to monitor dashboards + synthetic traces. I'll post periodic p50/p95/p99 snapshots. :eyes:

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: SLO sensitivity exercise starting in 10m (3429999490).

ops-lead: starting surge now (init canary in eu-west-1). Will post when we open global.

emma: p95 text-gen eu-west-1 jumped from 210ms -> 780ms at +45s, p99 to ~1.2s. no 5xxs observed. posting dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/slo-sens-2026

ops-lead: opening to us-west-2 at +5m. watch for KV cache warmup error spikes and increase in coldstart rates.

alex: seeing minor kube pod churn in eu-west-1 autoscaler, but healthy. no token loss reported.

ops-lead: exercise complete — stopping load. Quick summary: short-lived p99 spikes in eu-west-1 on text-gen, autoscaler reacted within target window, no customer-facing errors, fallback routing behaved as expected. Actions: 1) tune autoscaler lower cooldown for embedding pools, 2) add synthetic at higher qps to eu-west-1, 3) follow-up run in two weeks focused on coldstart penalty. I'll open a short postmortem and notify product owners. :thumbsup:

emma: thanks — will attach metric snapshots to the postmortem.

alex: great rehearsal, thx everyone.
